item.title: Group Dynamics
item.description: Current Projects: Judgement & decision-making Information sharing Judgment & decision-making {judg-dec} Group decisions are ubiquitous in everyday life. Even when decisions are made individually, decision-makers often receive advice or suggestions from others. Thus, decisions are often social in nature and involve multiple group members. The ways group members combine their preferences to make a group decision generally falls along two dimensions: how much interaction or information exchange is allowed among the group members and how the final decision is made.
